title: Room sensor open
fullDescription:
Kenmore window air conditioners display E1 when the room temperature thermistor circuit is open or shorted. The compressor will not run without a valid reading.

Check the connector at the control board and replace the sensor if necessary.

fixSteps.title: Check harness
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat thermistor connector.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new thermistor.

faq.q: Reset works?
faq.a: Only briefly if sensor is bad.

title: Coil sensor fault
fullDescription:
E2 indicates the indoor coil sensor is open or shorted. Used for freeze protection.

Replace sensor or check clip mount on coil.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Reattach clip and connect.

faq.q: Causes coil ice?
faq.a: Without sensor, controller cannot prevent freeze.

title: Fan motor stall
fullDescription:
E3 indicates the indoor blower motor failed to reach speed. Check for obstructions before suspecting motor failure.

A failed run capacitor on AC motors is also common.

fixSteps.title: Inspect blower
fixSteps.instruction: Remove front, spin wheel by hand.

faq.q: Run AC anyway?
faq.a: No, coil will ice.

title: EEPROM error
fullDescription:
E4 means the controller cannot read its calibration data. Often caused by surges; control board replacement is the fix.

Surge protector recommended after repair.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 30 minutes.

faq.q: Surge protector?
faq.a: Yes, recommended.

title: Display communication fault
shortDescription: Display board lost contact with main board.
fullDescription:
E5 indicates the display ribbon is loose or the UI board failed.

Reseat first, replace if needed.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Open bezel, reseat ribbon.

faq.q: Affects cooling?
faq.a: Eventually yes, since user input is blocked.

title: Frost protection active
fullDescription:
FP appears when the evaporator drops below freezing during operation. The compressor pauses while the fan continues to thaw the coil.

Dirty filters and low ambient temperatures are common triggers.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Wash mesh filter and dry.

faq.q: Auto recovery?
faq.a: Yes, after coil warms.

title: Air sensor failure
fullDescription:
AS is a variant of E1 on smart Kenmore models. Same diagnosis applies: replace the air thermistor.

The sensor is typically near the front grille.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap thermistor and reconnect.

faq.q: Same as E1?
faq.a: Functionally yes.

title: Drain pan full
fullDescription:
FL on portable Kenmore units indicates the condensate pan is full. Drain via the bottom port.

Check float for stuck position.

fixSteps.title: Drain
fixSteps.instruction: Place pan under drain port and remove plug.

faq.q: Continuous drain?
faq.a: Yes, attach hose for continuous mode.

title: Power failure
fullDescription:
PF flashes after a power interruption. Press a button to acknowledge.

No action required.

fixSteps.title: Acknowledge
fixSteps.instruction: Press any button.

faq.q: Settings lost?
faq.a: No.

title: Filter clean reminder
fullDescription:
C1 reminds the user to wash the air filter. The unit continues operating but airflow is reduced.

Wash and reset with the dedicated button.

fixSteps.title: Wash filter
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse with mild soap, dry, replace.

faq.q: How often?
faq.a: Every 2 weeks of heavy use.

title: Kenmore E6 — Compressor Drive Fault
shortDescription: Kenmore Air Conditioner error E6: The compressor inverter or drive circuit has reported an error and stopped the compressor.
fullDescription: Error code E6 on Kenmore air conditioners indicates the compressor inverter or drive circuit has reported an error and stopped the compressor. This condition normally locks out cooling or heating until the fault is cleared. Common causes include a defective inverter/compressor module, a loose or damaged wiring harness between the component and the main control board, or a failure of the control board itself. Begin with a hard power reset, then inspect the inverter/compressor module and its wiring before considering board replacement.
symptoms: E6 shown on the indoor display or remote
Compressor or fan does not start

fixSteps.title: Power reset
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect the unit from power for 5 minutes, then restore power and observe whether the error returns.

fixSteps.title: Inspect wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Open the service panel and verify all connectors at the main control board are fully seated and undamaged.

fixSteps.title: Test the suspect component
fixSteps.instruction: Use a multimeter to verify resistance or continuity of the affected sensor or component, and compare against service manual specs.

fixSteps.title: Replace the failed part
fixSteps.instruction: Order the matching replacement part for your model, install it in the same orientation, and reconnect all wiring before re-testing.

whenToCallPro: If basic checks do not clear the E6 code, an HVAC technician should be called to verify refrigerant pressures and inverter operation.
videoSearchQuery: Kenmore air conditioner E6 error fix

faq.q: What does E6 mean on a Kenmore air conditioner?
faq.a: The compressor inverter or drive circuit has reported an error and stopped the compressor.

faq.q: Can I run my Kenmore air conditioner with E6?
faq.a: No — most units lock out operation when E6 is active. Resolve the fault before continued use.
